title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → LearningManagement

source_tables.description: Training record. Employee training history with course, dates, status, score.
Learning component (ELM). Course definition, type, delivery method, credit hours.
ELM enrollment. Student enrollment in learning component with status and completion.
Compliance tracking. Required training by job code, department, or role. Due dates and completion status.
Certification tracking. Professional certifications, licenses, CPE credits.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Assessment score if applicable.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_LM_CI_COMPL exists for this employee + course
attribute_mappings.transformation: true if the training is compliance-required.
Compliance training due date. Cast to ISO 8601.
Date the training/certification expires and must be renewed.

notes: PeopleSoft has two training tracking paths: the legacy PS_TRAINING table (simple completion records) and Enterprise Learning Management (ELM) which is a full LMS. Many higher ed institutions use a mix — ELM for compliance training (Title IX, FERPA, cybersecurity, lab safety) and PS_TRAINING for external professional development. Compliance training completion is frequently audited and reported to HR leadership.
